Class RealEstate

java.lang.Object
com.kareym.realestate.hw08.RealEstate
public class RealEstate extends Object
Represents a real estate item with basic attributes and price calculation.

This class is used for Homework 08 and demonstrates: - Logging (INFO for method calls, SEVERE for exceptions) - JavaDoc documentation for methods

    • RealEstate

      public RealEstate(String city, double pricePerSqm, int sqm, double numberOfRooms, Genre genre) throws InvalidPropertyException
      Creates a new RealEstate object with the given parameters.
      Parameters:
      city - The city where the property is located.
      pricePerSqm - Price per square meter.
      sqm - Total area in square meters.
      numberOfRooms - Number of rooms (can be fractional).
      genre - Type of property.
      Throws:
      InvalidPropertyException - if any field is invalid.
